name: Eaton Magnum DS LV switchgear, 4000 A main bus
description: UL 1558 / ANSI C37.20.1 metal-enclosed drawout LV switchgear. Bus ratings 2000-10,000 A, breakers 800-6000 A, 100/150/200 kA bus bracing, 600 VAC class. 4000 A is the usual main for a 2.5-3 MVA, 480 V unit substation.

capacity_w.note: 4000 A x 480 V x sqrt(3) = 3.33 MW at unity pf. Lineup offered 2000-10,000 A (10,000 A = 8.31 MW at 480 V)

rating_a.note: one of the available cross bus ratings: 2000, 3200, 4000, 5000, 6000, 8000, 10,000 A

voltage_v.note: 480 V system (508 V max); 600 V class

short_circuit_a.note: standard bus bracing 100 kA; 150 and 200 kA optional

sources.title: Eaton Design Guide DG019004EN, Magnum DS rear-access low-voltage switchgear (Jan 2021)
